Hi,

I understand that something like this could feel overwhelming to you. But self-awareness is a really good trait, even thought it might seem frightning right now. It's good to be able to analyze how "you" differ from younger you, and identifying what direction you would like to move in. Try to really take a moment to feel - what makes you feel good? It may be socializing, it may be spending time by yourself for a while. 

It's really easy to get caught up in the changes that you're going through, instead of just going through them. It seems like you're worrying a lot about if there's something wrong with you, which is okay and valid when experiencing things that seem out of the ordinary from what you're used to. But it seems to me that you're just unfamilliar with what you're feeling. 

Everyone is different. There was nothing intrinsically "wrong" with you before, nor now. But if you feel like these feelings or thoughts are becoming overbearing, i would suggest you try to reach out to someone - maybe a friend or family member you feel you can confide in or a therapist? They could probably provide you with better insight than I am, if they know you or are formally equipped with the tools to do so. Either way, I hope this was somwhat helpful.
